kill_risks.claim: The search evidence shows category incumbents such as Shepherd, VetBadger, Veterian, and other veterinary practice-management platforms, but it does not establish that any specifically reconciles controlled-substance exports; therefore displacement and differentiation remain unproven.

Free or bundled alternatives are only weakly evidenced: AVMA offers practice-management resources, while mainstream PIMS products are shown as platforms for records, billing, and inventory. The evidence does not show a free tool that produces this audit packet, nor a buyer willing to pay for a standalone upload-and-reconcile utility.

The mechanism is not demonstrated for the modal failure case. The idea assumes a usable CSV/XLSX export plus configurable mappings and deterministic rules, but the search evidence says nothing about inconsistent schemas, missing or incorrect source data, multi-location workflows, prescriber verification, or whether reconciliation can establish an audit-ready record rather than merely flag discrepancies.

top.name: VetAuditMatch
top.one_liner: VetAuditMatch helps veterinary clinics recover billable work by pairing them with trained remote technicians who independently reconcile estimates with final invoices before revenue is lost.

top.name: OpenSlotLedger — Team-Wide Cancellation Capacity Ledger
top.one_liner: Give every role in an independent veterinary clinic a shared, auditable view of cancellations, no-shows, and recovered same-day capacity—without per-user seat fees or blind overbooking.

top.name: TraumaTap
top.one_liner: TraumaTap turns fast, verbal emergency-care actions into a complete, reviewable charge list without forcing staff through a slow PIMS workflow during treatment.

top.name: LegacyPriceLedger
top.one_liner: Give clinics a defensible, reviewable reconstruction of their own missing historical prices before importing records into a new PIMS.

top.name: VetLot Reconcile
top.one_liner: Turn a suspicious veterinary inventory export into an evidence-linked reconciliation report that explains which count discrepancies may be caused by FDA actions on specific lots.

evaluated_idea.name: AccreditedVetMapper
evaluated_idea.value_proposition: AccreditedVetMapper turns a clinic’s existing controlled-substance export into a reconciled, prescriber-verified audit packet without duplicate manual reporting or spreadsheet investigation.
evaluated_idea.mechanism_summary: This pairs deterministic controlled-substance reconciliation with a versioned USDA APHIS directory match and evidence-backed prescriber attestations, turning a fragmented monthly check into a portable audit packet outside the PIMS.
